newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR ON MARK GAINS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR ON MARK GAINS.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished the Wednesday session of the inter-bank forex market firmer against the dollar as the German mark gained ground against the U.S. currency, dealer said.
The forint ended at 177.00/05 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 177.42/47.
The Hungarian unit closed the session a shade weaker against the central bank's resistance level, opening the gap to between 10 and 15 pips from this morning's five pips.
The forint floats against the central bank's currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
